node.title: Coste total de una intervención
node.summary: Count discovery, activation, execution, governance, disruption, learning and closure within the boundary.

relations: A transformation business case should include the costs of looking, making binding declarations and absorbing their consequences, not only implementation expenditure.
No son tarifas ni porcentajes universales. Un esfuerzo de preparación real no es por sí mismo compensación evitable.
A Tiger Team evaluation should include activation, learning and closure costs, while distinguishing necessary mission work from avoidable compensation.
Intensidad, cansancio o coste no bastan para clasificar HID. TTC exige condición y fecha de salida, no una etiqueta indefinida.
